_comment: Mutation testing. The suite is a lib0/testing harness driven by a plain node entrypoint, so Stryker uses the command runner (exit code = pass/fail). That runner has no per-test coverage analysis, so every mutant pays a full suite run and a whole run takes well over an hour — use --mutate when iterating. CI splits the same mutants across parallel shards (stryker.shard.config.mjs, merged by scripts/mutation/merge-shards.mjs). Score went 53.07 -> 63.68 as the lifecycle and teardown paths gained real assertions; there are no uncovered mutants, so the remaining survivors are all reachable and break=60 should be raised as they are killed.
